newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-EX-ENGLAND HOOKER MOORE BANNED FOR 60 DAYS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-EX-ENGLAND HOOKER MOORE BANNED FOR 60 DAYS.

text.p: Brian Moore, Richmond's former England hooker, was suspended on Wednesday for 60 days after being sent off in a Cup match against Sale for trampling on lock Dave Baldwin in a ruck.
Moore, a solicitor, mounted a fierce defence, pleading that he went into the ruck carrying the ball and tried to walk over Baldwin, who had collapsed the maul.
Moore, England's most-capped hooker, plays for Richmond as an amateur and had never been sent off since starting his career in the England shirt 12 years ago.

Richmond captain Ben Clarke said: "I am very upset that he has been banned for so long. I had hoped that the sending-off would be penalty enough for Brian and Richmond because after he was sent off, the game went Sale's way and we were the losers.
"That cost us a place in the next round and we lost experience for our team and income the club."
The disciplinary panel was chaired by ex-Rugby Football Union (RFU) president Dennis Easby, a former referee.
